prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source style inspiration, transform the manga-style promotional image into a single serene watercolor anime illustration. Remove all comic panels, speech bubbles, typography, action effects, and advertising layout. Create a vertical scene of a young woman in a floral kimono viewed from behind in a three-quarter pose, standing on a wooden balcony and looking over a historic riverside Japanese town. Add spring cherry blossoms with branches framing the top, falling petals, and soft pink blossoms throughout the scene. Give the character an elegant updo with floral hair ornaments and have her hold a translucent traditional umbrella. Set the background with a blue river canal, traditional rooftops, and a distant pagoda or temple tower. Use delicate watercolor anime style: pale washes, soft paper texture, gentle blue and pink palette, luminous daylight, fine ink-like detail, and a calm romantic atmosphere. No text, no logos, no speech bubbles, no comic borders, no modern UI elements.

promptZh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为风格灵感来源，将漫画风格的宣传图转换为一幅宁静的水彩动漫插画。移除所有漫画分镜、对话气泡、排版文字、动作特效及广告布局。创作一个竖构图场景，主角为 一位身着花卉和服的年轻女性，以背影呈现，呈四分之三侧身姿态，站在木质阳台上俯瞰历史悠久的日本河畔小镇。添加 春季樱花，让枝条覆盖画面顶部，花瓣飘落，粉嫩的樱花点缀整个场景。为角色设计优雅的盘发，佩戴花卉发饰，并让她手持 一把半透明的传统油纸伞。背景设定为蓝色河道、传统屋顶以及远处的宝塔或寺庙塔楼。使用 细腻的水彩动漫风格：淡雅的色彩渲染、柔和的纸张质感、温和的蓝粉色调、明亮的日光、精细的墨线细节，营造出宁静浪漫的氛围。画面中不含任何文字、Logo、对话气泡、漫画边框或现代 UI 元素。
